reason: The gap explores the relationship between maternal weight gain during pregnancy and pre-pregnancy body mass index (BMI) categories within the context of sudden unexpected infant death syndrome (SUID). While prior literature suggests that maternal obesity increases SUID risk, this study aims to investigate how different levels of weight gain during pregnancy interact with pre-pregnancy BMI. This research would refine current understanding by providing more nuanced insights into how specific combinations of pre-pregnancy BMI and weight gain might influence SUID risk.
